verdict.rationale: EFTPS documents that sign-in requires credential MFA through Login.gov or ID.me, which an authorized human can complete remotely. However, enrollment ends with a PIN sent by U.S. Mail in five to seven business days, which is exactly the physical-mail wall the story rules out. Missing for 10: a fully remote path from enrollment to sign-in with no mailed PIN, and documentation of whether the Login.gov/ID.me flows avoid biometric liveness or in-person verification.
